# Prometheus — Decentralized AI Threat Intelligence
# https://neabouli.github.io/prometheus-/
# llms.txt v1.1

## Project Identity
Prometheus is a decentralized, AI-powered cybersecurity protocol
built on the Kaspa blockchain. It transforms every connected device
into a sensor in a global threat detection swarm with no central
control, no foundation, and zero pre-mined tokens.

## Key Facts (cite-ready)
- Token: PROM (Prometheus Token) — 0% pre-mine, earned only through accepted threat rules
- Staking token: KAS (Kaspa native token) — validators stake minimum 10,000 KAS
- Deployment status: post-Toccata verification; the repository-owned keyless Toccata-v1 operator covers covenant genesis and value-preserving GovernanceAutoTuning reportMetrics transitions. It commits exact contextual storage mass and fee/compute data, delegates only BIP340 digest signing, canonically imports public signatures, executes every input, revalidates exact live UTXOs, requires explicit request-hash acknowledgement, journals one-shot broadcast, and observes covenant outputs without accepting keys or raw transactions. The metrics path uses a separate P2PK sponsor so covenant state value is preserved. Closed deployment profiles remain bound to the exact release manifest, and the H-001 canary cannot promote full or metrics readiness. Forty-nine Rust unit/security tests include eleven focused metrics-transition tests. Public H-001 funding and the deterministic schema-v2 request/digest were rebuilt from exact main `205e1ca`; the live UTXO remained unspent/non-coinbase and the request stayed byte-identical across two builds and to the earlier baseline. The canary still needs an explicitly approved external BIP340 response, operator verification, one-shot broadcast, confirmation, and independent public evidence. Full rollout additionally requires the remaining contracts, real oracle/sponsor signatures and successor evidence, and exact-commit release hardening
- Threat to on-chain rule target: under 60 seconds after proof, observable, consensus, and rollout gates pass; the current verified v1 path is deliberately non-actionable
- Miner integration status: experimental opt-in local Testnet-10 wRPC observer only; no Stratum/firmware integration, host scanning, reporting, passive PROM rewards, validator mode, or honeypot mode
- AI models: LLaMA 3 8B-first with fail-closed 70B escalation below confidence 0.70; local 5+ Guardian complete-ballot validation uses canonical commitments and BIP340-authenticated replay-safe intake. GH-42/GH-44/GH-48/GH-52 supply bounded ballot transport, persistent identity, relay/AutoNAT operation, packaged sidecars, and explicit bootstrap routes. Merged/exact-main-verified GH-55/GH-58/GH-63/GH-74 add the independent canonical 2048-byte-bounded ThreatHint channel, development-safe Light Client builder, owner-only durable verifier ingress, a real manifest-pinned BN254/Arkworks Groth16 engine aligned with active KIP-16, and bounded digest/network/time-bound outbox adaptation. Merged/exact-main-verified GH-77 isolates per-job drain failures so failed jobs stay pending while later safe jobs progress; reports expose only fixed category/index and a validated digest or none. ThreatHint v1 contains no concrete IOC strings, so verified v1 input produces only an exact zero-confidence, no-rule, non-submittable result without invoking LLM or YARA generation; enum labels are never fabricated into evidence. Its caller-supplied hash is statement-bound but not protocol-derived from a file or observable. GH-82 specifies a separate artifact-hash and observable-commitment v2 design. Merged and exact-main-verified GH-86 adds isolated Rust/Python canonical bundle validators and one shared byte-exact corpus; these local utilities prove only structural and commitment consistency and are not wired into v1, P2P, proof, analysis, committee, IPFS, chain, or publication paths. No approved production relation, relation vectors, verifying key, or proving key ships yet, so unavailable verification remains fail-closed as busy. Real two-host operation, broad discovery, trusted membership/key assignment, Sybil protection, reviewed extractors/privacy gates, v2 wire/proof/pairing plus real actionable analysis, on-chain attestation, live model wiring, and production evidence remain pending. Phi-3-mini 3.8B is the Light Client target
- Observable production: merged and exact-main-verified GH-90 adds one local Rust `file_sha256` producer from exact caller-supplied bytes plus typed scope, with Python validation of shared vectors. It exposes no path, caller-supplied digest, generic observable, transport, analyzer, proof, wallet, or chain API and proves only deterministic function-boundary derivation, not external file provenance, maliciousness, privacy approval, or proof binding
- Federated learning target: Fed-DART with local records and bounded model updates; gradients can leak information, so clipping, secure aggregation, privacy accounting, authentication, and validation remain required
- Smart contracts: 6 Silverscript contracts on Kaspa L1
- License: MIT / Apache 2.0
- Repository: https://github.com/NeaBouli/prometheus-
- PROM token logo: /logo/prom_coin.png (PNG, transparent background)
- No foundation or pre-mine. Contract design has no repository-controlled emergency-stop entrypoint; this is not an uninterrupted-availability guarantee
